nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.desc: Text is split into chunks from a fixed vocabulary; each has an integer ID ([explained](msg:2026-01-05.5)).

nodes.label: Special tokens
nodes.desc: Reserved tokens that mark structure. Not covered in detail yet.

nodes.label: BPE
nodes.desc: How the vocabulary is built. Unknown territory so far.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Each token scores earlier tokens with q · k and takes a weighted sum of their values ([explained](msg:2026-01-06.5), [example](msg:2026-01-06.7)).

nodes.label: Multi-head
nodes.desc: Many small heads in parallel, each its own lookup ([why](msg:2026-01-06.17)).

nodes.label: Causal mask
nodes.desc: A token may only look at itself and earlier tokens. Not covered yet.

nodes.label: KV cache
nodes.desc: Keys and values of earlier tokens kept in memory during generation ([preview](msg:2026-01-08.13)).

nodes.label: Softmax + T
nodes.desc: Turns logits into probabilities; T scales the gaps ([explained](msg:2026-01-05.10)).

nodes.label: Decoding
nodes.desc: Greedy or sampled. Not covered yet.

nodes.label: Cross-entropy loss
nodes.desc: Graded on the probability of the correct next token ([explained](msg:2026-01-08.5)).

nodes.label: Gradient descent
nodes.desc: Step every weight against its gradient ([explained](msg:2026-01-08.8)).

nodes.label: Backprop
nodes.desc: How the gradients are computed. Not covered yet.
